name: LOVATO ADXL0060600 soft starter
summary: 60 A soft starter with an internal bypass for three-phase motor starting.
description: Place the starter between supply and motor cable zones while retaining access to its control terminals. Include upstream protection and any selected rail-mount accessory as separate objects.
Use the linked manufacturer CAD for dimensions and the exact selected configuration. The downloadable illustration here is original educational geometry, unitless and not to scale.
readingNotes: The documented operational supply is 208–600 V AC and auxiliary supply is 100–240 V AC; these are different circuit interfaces.
A soft starter controls starting and stopping; it is not a variable-frequency drive for continuous speed control.
drawingChecklist: Check cooling space and allowed mounting arrangement in the instructions.
Separate power terminations from control and communication wiring.
